name: Leonard Redway
office: City of Inglewood, Member of the City Council, 1st District

items.text: Leonard Redway is a member of Inglewood's Construction Appeals Board, appointed in 2023 to represent District 1. He is a plumber who has called for a more transparent city government that works for the needs of residents. He supports limiting billboard advertising in the city.
